questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ville gerne have at det var en europæisk by.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Rimelig nemt. UvA var nemme at få fat i og de sendte e-mails undervejs med den vigtigste information.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik ikke rigtig nogen assistance, men det var fordi jeg ankom efter intro-dagene.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik et kollegieværelse gennem UvA, så det var nemt. Men det er også fordi jeg var heldig at få en plads i student-housing-lotteriet.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: At det er fint at bo off-campus. Tror ikke UvA har nogle on-campus værelser.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg var rigtig glad for mit kollegieværelse på Prinsengracht, som var en af bygningerne, som UvA tilbød kollegieværelser i.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det var en fin proces. De er gode til at sende reminder-e-mails med deadlines osv. som man skal huske.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kunne nemt række ud til enten exchange-kontoret eller til min department - Economics and Business Economics.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde lidt svært ved at vælge fag, da UvA ikke udbød nogle af de prioriterede valgfag, som jeg egentlig ville have haft på KU, hvis jeg havde været hjemme på 5. semester. Jeg endte med at vælge valgfag i stedet.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: At kigge i UvA's course catalogue i forhold til at vælge fag.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Mine fag var ret forskellige i niveau. Jeg synes nogle af dem var for svære, og nogle af dem passende. Generelt er niveauet ret højt på UvA, så jeg har læst ret meget mens jeg har været afsted. Jeg uddyber længere nede...

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Forelæserne på UvA gik ikke rigtig op i at vi fik pauser, som de ellers virkelig respekterer her på KU, i hvert fald som jeg oplever det. Selve undervisningen på UvA var meget forskellig fra fag til fag - nogle holdtimer var obligatoriske og nogle ikke. Nogle fag havde fremlæggelser, andre ikke.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Money and Banking, Environmental Economics, International Trade and Investment, Behavioral Economics og Finance 1 for Business.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Jeg kan ikke anbefale Money and Banking eller Finance 1 for Business. Begge fag har midterms, hvilket jeg syntes var alt for krævende, nu hvor UvA også har blokstruktur. Det vil sige, at man allerede går til midterm efter 3-4 uger af at have haft faget, og hvis man ikke består den, så er det svært at bestå den endelige eksamen. Det er også lidt hardcore, når man i forvejen er i gang med at falde til, allerede at skulle forholde sig til eksamen. Så jeg kan generelt anbefale at vælge fag, der ikke har midterms. 

Environmental Economics var rigtig fint, men handlede ikke om makroøkonomiske modeller med klimaeffekter, som jeg lidt havde regnet med. Det handlede mere om at gennemgå studier, fremlægge om dem og lære derigennem. Ingen midterm.

Behavioral Economics var fedt. Rigtig engageret forelæser, der gjorde det spændende. Man skulle lave et eksperiment til holdundervisningen med en gruppe og så fremlægge resultater derfra. Det var virkelig fedt. Ingen midterm.

questions.answer: Ikke rigtig nogle faktisk.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Supermarkedet er i hvert fald billigere end i Danmark, så det var en god ting. Det samme hvis man skal købe kaffe eller andet. Generelt billigere.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg var på basket-holdet på USC, som foregik i Science Park. Det var mega fedt. Det kostede dog cirka 1500-2000 DKK for et semester. Man skulle melde sig til 'try-outs' hvilket jeg fandt på deres Instagram.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Kan helt klart anbefale de sportsaktiviteter der foregår i Science Park. De har alle mulige slags sport - der er vidst også et fitness center.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag til Jordaan, tag til de Pijp og om sommeren er der også særligt fedt i Øst.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Synes det var ret smooth - der er ikke så stor en kulturel forskel, og hollændere er generelt temmelig tjekkede, ligesom i DK.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Jeg snakkede ikke med så mange lokale, da jeg ikke havde fag med dem, så det var svært at komme i kontakt.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Synes ikke rigtig at der var nogle kulturelle forskelle, der var udfordrende.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At hollændere er super direkte - det er ret nice. At de er tjekkede. At der er cykel-kultur.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- Kan ikke anbefale at vælge fag med midterms - så skal man i hvert fald lige være forberedt på det. Forbered dig generelt på at skulle læse ok meget.
- Meld dig til student-housing-lotteriet, og hvis du så får en plads, så vælg Prinsengracht, hvor jeg boede. Fantastisk lokation og sted!
- Vær' med til introdagene/ugerne. Det var jeg ikke, og ville ønske jeg havde været.
- Og kan anbefale at blive i Amsterdam alle 3 blokke, altså også i blok 3 i januar. Jeg havde nemlig planlagt at tage hjem til jul, men endte med at blive i januar også.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Nej.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Har fået nogle dejlige venner. Og det var bare rart at blive sat lidt ud af KU-konteksten og opleve noget nyt.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Nok nogle af de svære fag, som jeg havde valgt.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
